solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Crematory art at assembled collection of sculptures

indicators.note: assembled means put together from parts, so the letters of these three words are built into a new order

explanation.surface: Some odd art is put together at a crematorium.
explanation.walkthrough: 'assembled' rearranges the fourteen letters of CREMATORY ART AT into the two words of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The thousands of clay soldiers buried with China's first emperor at Xi'an form a famous group of statues.

clue.text: To be full of private emotion

indicators.note: of signals that the letters come out of the run of words that follows, spanning the word gap

explanation.surface: Someone is brimming with feelings they keep to themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: To swarm or abound, as a river with fish, is to be crowded or packed with something.

clue.text: Performance I crashed into after break

indicators.note: after places the crashed letters behind the word for break

parts.note: to rend is to tear or break apart

indicators.note: crashed suggests something smashed up, so the letters of I and into are jumbled

explanation.surface: A performer flops after an interval and falls apart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crashed' makes ITION; 'break' looks like an interval but is the verb meaning tear.
explanation.definitionFit: A rendition is a rendering or interpretation of a song or piece, so it is a musical or dramatic delivery.

clue.text: Put up with a tender knee finally

parts.note: to tender is to offer, and a bid is an offer

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of the word knee

explanation.surface: Someone tolerates a sore knee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tender' reads as sore, but it is the verb meaning offer.
explanation.definitionFit: To abide something is to tolerate or bear it, as in 'I can't abide noise'.

clue.text: Resistance during power failure resulted in fury

indicators.note: during places one piece within the span of the other, here the letter sits inside the blackout word

parts.note: an outage is a cut in the electricity supply
R is the physics symbol for electrical resistance

explanation.surface: People resisted through a blackout, and anger followed.
explanation.definitionFit: Outrage is fierce indignation or anger at something shocking.

clue.text: Framework measure at risk without walls surrounding

indicators.note: surrounding means the trimmed letters go around the measure
walls are the outer edges, so the first and last letters of 'at risk' are dropped

parts.note: an ell is an old measure of length, roughly an arm's length of cloth

explanation.surface: A building's structure is endangered once its walls are gone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without walls' leaves TRIS, the middle of the two words taken together; 'surrounding' wraps it round the measure.
explanation.definitionFit: A trellis is a lattice of wooden strips used to support climbing plants, a light open structure.

clue.text: See 1
Another broadcast on career

parts.note: re means about or concerning, as on does in 'a talk on art'
to career is to rush along, to run

explanation.surface: A programme about someone's working life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'career' looks like a noun meaning working life, but it is the verb meaning to hurtle.
explanation.definitionFit: A repeat showing of a TV programme is a second airing of something already shown.

clue.text: Yes, tyre crack received attention in the past

indicators.note: crack here means break apart, so the letters of tyre are rearranged

parts.note: to have someone's ear is to have their attention

explanation.surface: A cracked tyre once got noticed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crack' makes TERY; 'received' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means time gone by, the days of old, used here as an adverbial phrase for former times.

clue.text: Attractive take-home pay in the occult

indicators.note: in places the pay word inside the word for the occult

parts.note: magic is the art of supernatural powers
net pay is what is left after deductions

explanation.surface: Bringing home a salary from the supernatural business is appealing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something with magnetism draws people or objects towards it, so it pulls in admirers.

clue.text: Don left out innuendo — producing boredom

indicators.note: left out says the letters of the name Don are taken away from the longer word
producing suggests making something new from the remaining letters, which are reordered

explanation.surface: An academic omits suggestive remarks, making the lecture dull.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking D, O, N from INNUENDO leaves I, N, U, E, N, which 'producing' rearranges. A 'Don' is a university lecturer.
explanation.definitionFit: Ennui is a French-borrowed word for weariness and listlessness from lack of interest.

clue.text: House he's found in reference book

indicators.note: found in places these letters inside the zodiac sign

parts.note: Taurus is one of the twelve houses or signs of the zodiac
taken as written, apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: A man in a house is discovered with a reference book.
explanation.walkthrough: In astrology the zodiac signs are called houses, so 'House' is Taurus.
explanation.definitionFit: A thesaurus is a book listing words grouped by meaning, consulted to find synonyms.

clue.text: Live wire at the dance after excitement

indicators.note: after places the dance word behind the excitement word

parts.note: fire means passion or ardour
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: An energetic person shows up at the dance once the excitement has started.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Live wire' reads as an electric cable but means an energetic, lively person.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are idioms for a dynamic, energetic person full of life.

clue.text: Name a single occasion for the present

parts.note: once means on one occasion only

explanation.surface: Naming a one-off event as a gift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'present' looks like a gift, but it means the present time, as in the phrase 'for the nonce'.
explanation.definitionFit: The word survives in the phrase 'for the nonce', meaning for now, for the time being.

clue.text: Physically challenged soldier floating down with leg wrapped in film

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper, who descends by parachute

indicators.note: wrapped in places the limb inside the word for film

parts.note: pic is short for picture, a film
taken as written

explanation.surface: A soldier descends by parachute with a leg bandaged, in a film.
explanation.definitionFit: A paraplegic person has paralysis of the legs and lower body, a disability.

clue.text: Enliven a Northern Ireland colleague

parts.note: a mate is a fellow worker or companion

explanation.surface: Cheering up a workmate from Belfast.
explanation.definitionFit: To animate is to bring life or liveliness to something.

clue.text: Total absence leads to old lover undergoing tearful emotions

parts.note: abs is the abbreviation for absent or absence, as marked on a school register

indicators.note: leads to means the front letters of the following words are taken

explanation.surface: Being apart from a former partner brings on tears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Total absence' reads as one phrase, but 'Total' is the definition and 'leads to' picks the opening letters of the last five words.
explanation.definitionFit: Absolute means complete or utter, as in absolute silence, the whole amount.

clue.text: One down rising to please

definitions.meaning: the entry at 1-down, TEEM, read upwards gives MEET, as in meeting a need
to please is to gratify or content someone

explanation.surface: A rising figure is reaching out to please.
explanation.walkthrough: The first definition is itself wordplay: '1 Down' is TEEM, and 'rising' turns it upward into MEET, which means the same as the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To meet a demand or to please someone are both to fulfil wishes or content them.

clue.text: "I'm sinless" articulated disgusting quality

indicators.note: articulated means jointed or reassembled at joints, so the letters are put together in another order

explanation.surface: Someone claims aloud to be sinless, which is rather repellent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'articulated' seems to mean spoken, but here it means jointed, so the letters are reassembled.
explanation.definitionFit: Sliminess is the state of being slimy, both literally slippery and figuratively oily and unpleasant.

clue.text: Mother back with anise treatment for loss of memory

indicators.note: back says the word for mother is turned to read the other way

parts.note: ma is a familiar word for mother

indicators.note: treatment suggests something worked over, so the letters of anise are rearranged

explanation.surface: Mum returns with an aniseed remedy for forgetfulness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns MA into AM; 'treatment' rearranges ANISE into NESIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Amnesia is the medical term for a partial or total inability to recall past events.

clue.text: State takes a long time — this is mean

parts.note: to aver is to declare or assert
an age is a very long time, as in 'it took ages'

explanation.surface: A government takes forever, and it is nasty about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'State' looks like a nation, but it is the verb meaning declare; 'mean' looks like unkind but is the statistical sense.
explanation.definitionFit: The arithmetic mean is the usual sense of an average: the sum divided by the count.

clue.text: See 27
Friend upset after deliveries coincide

indicators.note: after places the overturned friend behind the cricket word

parts.note: in cricket an over is a set of six balls bowled, or deliveries

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so the friend word reads from the bottom up

parts.note: a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: A friend is upset after some deliveries turn up at the same time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deliveries' looks like parcels; in cricket, the game's bowled balls are grouped into overs of six.
explanation.definitionFit: When two things overlap they partly cover the same ground or happen at the same time.

clue.text: Watering hole in the neighbourhood

definitions.meaning: a pub one regularly drinks at, the nearest bar
nearby, belonging to the area close at hand

explanation.definitionFit: In Britain, one's regular nearby pub is called 'the local', and the adjective means nearby.

clue.text: Support companion always

parts.note: CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order
e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, meaning always

explanation.surface: Backing a friend forever.
explanation.walkthrough: CH, Companion of Honour, is a British honour.
explanation.definitionFit: To cheer a team is to encourage or back it with shouts.

clue.text: To re-elect Richard Nixon was essentially startling

indicators.note: essentially means in its essence or inner part, so the letters lie within the words

explanation.surface: Voting Richard Nixon back in was a shock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nixon' only completes the surface; the letters sit within RE-ELECT RICHARD.
explanation.definitionFit: Electric is used figuratively for something thrilling or sudden, as an electric atmosphere.

clue.text: Electron accelerator producing a native salt

indicators.note: producing here means bringing forth from within, so the letters come out of the two words

explanation.surface: A particle accelerator yields a mineral.
explanation.walkthrough: 'native' means naturally occurring, as a mineral is.
explanation.definitionFit: Trona is a naturally occurring mineral, a hydrated sodium carbonate mined as a source of soda ash.

clue.text: Principal game of chance

definitions.meaning: an old dice game, a forerunner of hazard; also a match in cockfighting

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means chief; the noun was an old gambling game played with dice.

clue.text: Territorial protection from a whole flat racing programme

indicators.note: programme here means to arrange or order things, so the letters are set out in a new order

explanation.surface: A whole flat-racing schedule.
explanation.walkthrough: 'programme' looks like a race card, but it rearranges A WHOLE FLAT RACING; 'from' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient defensive fortification in northern China was built to guard an empire's borders.

clue.text: Watch a precious stone beginning to opalise back

indicators.note: back says the whole run of pieces is read the other way

parts.note: a gem is a precious stone

indicators.note: beginning to takes the first letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A watch with a jewel whose opal gleam is starting to show.
explanation.walkthrough: A + GEM + O reads AGEMO; 'back' turns it around.
explanation.definitionFit: Omega is a well-known Swiss brand of wristwatch, so a timepiece.

clue.text: Rope in agreement without a consensus at first

indicators.note: without says the following letters are removed from the agreement word

parts.note: accord means agreement or harmony

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letter of consensus

explanation.surface: Being roped into a deal without everyone agreeing.
explanation.walkthrough: ACCORD loses A and C (the opening letter of 'consensus').
explanation.definitionFit: A cord is a thin rope or string made of twisted strands.

clue.text: Monitor to continue to wear labels?

definitions.meaning: to watch over or observe closely
read literally, to go on having tabs, or labels, on

explanation.surface: Checking whether to keep the price tags on.
explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is whimsical, flagged by the question mark: keep (continue) tabs (labels) on (wearing).
explanation.definitionFit: To watch someone closely is an idiom for keeping a close eye on their activities.
